classified_cves.summary: SonicBOOM RISC-V处理器版本3.0.0中存在LR指令实现缺陷。当加载操作成功转换但产生异常时，处理器未能避免获取保留权限，可能导致非预期的内存访问行为。该漏洞影响处理器的内存一致性保障机制。
key_points: LR（Load Reserved）指令实现缺陷
异常处理过程中错误获取内存保留权限
影响RISC-V处理器的内存原子操作正确性
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V架构中的LR/SC（Load Reserved/Store Conditional）原子操作机制。具体而言，当LR指令执行时：1）地址转换成功完成（通过MMU），但指令执行过程中产生了其他异常（如中断、页面错误等）；2）处理器在这种情况下仍错误地获取了目标地址的保留权限；3）这破坏了LR/SC原子操作的正确语义，可能导致后续SC指令在不应成功的情况下错误执行，破坏多核环境下的内存一致性。该漏洞主要影响采用SonicBOOM微架构的RISC-V处理器，涉及内存管理单元与异常处理机制的协同设计缺陷。

descriptions.value: An issue was discovered in SonicBOOM riscv-boom 3.0.0. For LR, it does not avoid acquiring a reservation in the case where a load translates successfully but still generates an exception.

classified_cves.summary: RISC-V指令集手册中关于MTVEC寄存器的初始状态定义存在模糊性，可能导致系统启动时执行非法指令。该漏洞可能引发信息泄露、数据篡改和拒绝服务攻击。
key_points: MTVEC寄存器初始状态未明确定义
漏洞影响机器模式异常向量基地址设置
可能导致特权级安全机制被绕过
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞源于RISC-V特权架构规范对MTVEC（Machine Trap Vector Base Address）寄存器复位值的定义不明确。在系统启动过程中，若MTVEC寄存器未正确初始化，可能指向任意内存地址。攻击者可利用此特性：1) 通过预置恶意代码在可能指向的地址空间实现代码执行 2) 破坏异常处理机制导致系统崩溃 3) 结合其他漏洞提升权限。该问题影响所有遵循该规范实现的RISC-V处理器，需通过固件更新明确初始化序列来修复。

classified_cves.summary: 该CVE涉及Linux内核中RISC-V架构的kprobe实现缺陷。当在sys_read系统调用入口设置kprobe时，会导致内核触发BUG_ON崩溃，具体表现为在执行单步调试过程中出现指令页错误异常处理不当。
key_points: kprobe在sys_read入口替换指令为ebreak导致异常
单步调试期间清除SIE中断使能位引发问题
指令页错误异常处理逻辑存在缺陷
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞的技术细节如下：1) kprobe在sys_read入口将第一条指令替换为ebreak指令；2) 执行到ebreak时陷入断点处理程序，在准备单步执行原指令时会备份sstatus并清除SIE位禁用中断；3) 恢复执行时若指令槽的页表项未填充，会触发指令页错误异常（scause=0xc）；4) 页错误异常处理程序根据kprobe状态（KPROBE_HIT_SS）采取错误策略，最终导致__find_get_block中的BUG_ON被触发。漏洞根源在于RISC-V架构下kprobe单步执行与页错误处理的交互逻辑存在缺陷。

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的EFI/FDT初始化过程中，当系统未找到有效的设备树（FDT）时，会导致内核恐慌（panic）。该问题在RISC-V架构上被发现，需要及时处理无效FDT的情况。
key_points: setup_arch()调用efi_init()->efi_get_fdt_params()时未处理无效FDT情况
当initial_boot_params为null时继续执行FDT处理导致内核恐慌
漏洞在RISC-V架构上被发现和报告
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞的技术细节如下：在Linux内核启动过程中，setup_arch()函数会调用EFI初始化链（efi_init()->efi_get_fdt_params()）。如果系统没有找到有效的设备树（Flattened Device Tree），initial_boot_params指针将保持为null值。然而代码没有对此情况进行适当检查，继续执行后续的FDT处理操作，最终导致内核发生panic。这个问题在RISC-V架构上特别明显，因为RISC-V系统高度依赖设备树进行硬件描述和配置。修复方案是在检测到initial_boot_params为null时立即停止进一步的FDT处理流程。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

efi/fdt: fix panic when no valid fdt found

setup_arch() would invoke efi_init()->efi_get_fdt_params(). If no
valid fdt found then initial_boot_params will be null. So we
should stop further fdt processing here. I encountered this
issue on risc-v.

cna.title: efi/fdt: fix panic when no valid fdt found

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞是Linux内核在RISC-V架构上的指令缓存同步问题。当内核进行动态代码修补时，当前CPU的指令缓存未及时刷新，导致执行了陈旧的非法指令。这主要影响SiFive Unmatched平台的内核启动过程。
key_points: 指令缓存同步时序问题
动态代码修补过程中的缓存一致性缺陷
多核架构下的缓存管理漏洞
classified_cves.technical_details:
技术细节：
1. 漏洞触发场景：在ftrace进行动态代码修补时，对riscv_cpuid_to_hartid_mask函数进行指令替换
2. 根本原因：patch_text_nosync在修补指令后调用flush_icache_range，但该函数通过sbi_remote_fence_i仅刷新其他CPU的指令缓存，而未刷新当前CPU的缓存
3. 具体表现：当前CPU继续执行旧的缓存指令，导致非法指令异常，引发内核恐慌
4. 修复方案：在要求其他CPU刷新指令缓存之前，先刷新当前CPU的指令缓存，确保缓存一致性

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: Flush current cpu icache before other cpus

On SiFive Unmatched, I recently fell onto the following BUG when booting:

[    0.000000] ftrace: allocating 36610 entries in 144 pages
[    0.000000] Oops - illegal instruction [#1]
[    0.000000] Modules linked in:
[    0.000000] CPU: 0 PID: 0 Comm: swapper Not tainted 5.13.1+ #5
[    0.000000] Hardware name: SiFive HiFive Unmatched A00 (DT)
[    0.000000] epc : riscv_cpuid_to_hartid_mask+0x6/0xae
[    0.000000]  ra : __sbi_rfence_v02+0xc8/0x10a
[    0.000000] epc : ffffffff80007240 ra : ffffffff80009964 sp : ffffffff81803e10
[    0.000000]  gp : ffffffff81a1ea70 tp : ffffffff8180f500 t0 : ffffffe07fe30000
[    0.000000]  t1 : 0000000000000004 t2 : 0000000000000000 s0 : ffffffff81803e60
[    0.000000]  s1 : 0000000000000000 a0 : ffffffff81a22238 a1 : ffffffff81803e10
[    0.000000]  a2 : 0000000000000000 a3 : 0000000000000000 a4 : 0000000000000000
[    0.000000]  a5 : 0000000000000000 a6 : ffffffff8000989c a7 : 0000000052464e43
[    0.000000]  s2 : ffffffff81a220c8 s3 : 0000000000000000 s4 : 0000000000000000
[    0.000000]  s5 : 0000000000000000 s6 : 0000000200000100 s7 : 0000000000000001
[    0.000000]  s8 : ffffffe07fe04040 s9 : ffffffff81a22c80 s10: 0000000000001000
[    0.000000]  s11: 0000000000000004 t3 : 0000000000000001 t4 : 0000000000000008
[    0.000000]  t5 : ffffffcf04000808 t6 : ffffffe3ffddf188
[    0.000000] status: 0000000200000100 badaddr: 0000000000000000 cause: 0000000000000002
[    0.000000] [<ffffffff80007240>] riscv_cpuid_to_hartid_mask+0x6/0xae
[    0.000000] [<ffffffff80009474>] sbi_remote_fence_i+0x1e/0x26
[    0.000000] [<ffffffff8000b8f4>] flush_icache_all+0x12/0x1a
[    0.000000] [<ffffffff8000666c>] patch_text_nosync+0x26/0x32
[    0.000000] [<ffffffff8000884e>] ftrace_init_nop+0x52/0x8c
[    0.000000] [<ffffffff800f051e>] ftrace_process_locs.isra.0+0x29c/0x360
[    0.000000] [<ffffffff80a0e3c6>] ftrace_init+0x80/0x130
[    0.000000] [<ffffffff80a00f8c>] start_kernel+0x5c4/0x8f6
[    0.000000] ---[ end trace f67eb9af4d8d492b ]---
[    0.000000] Kernel panic - not syncing: Attempted to kill the idle task!
[    0.000000] ---[ end Kernel panic - not syncing: Attempted to kill the idle task! ]---

While ftrace is looping over a list of addresses to patch, it always failed
when patching the same function: riscv_cpuid_to_hartid_mask. Looking at the
backtrace, the illegal instruction is encountered in this same function.
However, patch_text_nosync, after patching the instructions, calls
flush_icache_range. But looking at what happens in this function:

flush_icache_range -> flush_icache_all
                   -> sbi_remote_fence_i
                   -> __sbi_rfence_v02
                   -> riscv_cpuid_to_hartid_mask

The icache and dcache of the current cpu are never synchronized between the
patching of riscv_cpuid_to_hartid_mask and calling this same function.

So fix this by flushing the current cpu's icache before asking for the other
cpus to do the same.

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的RISC-V BPF JIT编译器中，当JIT编译器在NR_JIT_ITERATIONS步骤内无法收敛时，会导致jit_data->header为NULL，进而引发空指针解引用问题。通过添加参数检查可避免此漏洞。
key_points: RISC-V架构的BPF JIT编译器存在空指针解引用漏洞
当JIT编译无法在指定迭代次数内收敛时触发
bpf_jit_binary_free()函数未对NULL参数进行检查
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞的技术细节如下：1) RISC-V BPF JIT编译器在编译过程中需要多次迭代优化；2) 当超过NR_JIT_ITERATIONS最大迭代次数仍未收敛时，jit_data->header会被设置为NULL；3) 后续调用bpf_jit_binary_free()函数时未检查参数有效性，直接对NULL指针进行解引用操作，导致内核崩溃或潜在的安全风险。修复方案是在调用bpf_jit_binary_free()前添加NULL检查。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv, bpf: Fix potential NULL dereference

The bpf_jit_binary_free() function requires a non-NULL argument. When
the RISC-V BPF JIT fails to converge in NR_JIT_ITERATIONS steps,
jit_data->header will be NULL, which triggers a NULL
dereference. Avoid this by checking the argument, prior calling the
function.

cna.title: riscv, bpf: Fix potential NULL dereference

classified_cves.summary: CVE-2022-26296是伯克利乱序执行RISC-V处理器中的一个侧信道漏洞。攻击者可通过本地用户访问权限利用该漏洞泄露敏感信息。该漏洞存在于特定版本的BOOM处理器实现中。
key_points: 侧信道信息泄露漏洞
需要本地用户访问权限
影响BOOM处理器特定版本(d77c2c3)

classified_cves.summary: CVE-2022-34636涉及CVA6和RISCV-Boom处理器核心在地址转换过程中存在异常类型处理错误。当发生物理内存属性(PMA)违规时，系统未能正确实现相应的异常类型。该漏洞可能影响处理器的内存保护机制和系统稳定性。
key_points: 地址转换过程中的PMA违规异常处理错误
影响CVA6和RISCV-Boom两个开源RISC-V处理器核心
异常类型实现不正确可能导致安全边界绕过
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞具体表现为：在RISC-V处理器的地址转换过程中，当发生物理内存属性(PMA)违规时，系统本应触发正确的异常类型（如访问错误异常），但实际实现的异常类型存在错误。PMA违规通常发生在处理器尝试访问不符合内存区域属性（如执行不可执行区域、写入只读区域等）的情况下。错误的异常类型可能导致：1）系统无法正确处理内存保护违规；2）可能被利用来绕过内存保护机制；3）影响操作系统的异常处理流程。该漏洞涉及两个重要的开源RISC-V实现：CVA6（原名Ariane）和RISCV-Boom，两者都在特定提交版本中存在此问题。

descriptions.value: CVA6 commit d315ddd0f1be27c1b3f27eb0b8daf471a952299a and RISCV-Boom commit ad64c5419151e5e886daee7084d8399713b46b4b implements the incorrect exception type when a PMA violation occurs during address translation.

classified_cves.summary: CVE-2022-34641涉及CVA6和RISCV-Boom处理器核心中的PMP（物理内存保护）漏洞。当在地址转换过程中发生PMP违规时，处理器会触发错误的异常类型。该漏洞可能导致安全机制失效，影响系统的内存保护能力。

影响地址转换过程中的内存保护机制
涉及CVA6和RISCV-Boom两个开源处理器核心

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞是Linux内核在RISC-V架构上的一个内核空指针解引用问题。当启用irqsoff延迟跟踪器时，由于帧指针设置不当，导致trace_hardirqs_on/off函数在获取调用者信息时触发内存访问错误。
key_points: 帧指针设置问题：汇编入口代码未正确设置$fp寄存器作为帧指针
宏调用风险：CALLER_ADDR1宏依赖正确的帧指针来获取返回地址
内存访问错误：在trace_hardirqs_on函数中访问无效内存地址0x00000000000000f8
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞技术细节如下：1) RISC-V架构的汇编入口代码中，$s0寄存器被用于存储任务标志而非作为帧指针；2) trace_hardirqs_{on,off}函数使用__builtin_return_address(1)宏获取调用者信息，该宏依赖正确的帧指针设置；3) 当$fp寄存器未被正确设置为帧指针时，生成的汇编代码'ld s2,-8(a1)'会尝试从错误的内存地址读取数据，导致空指针解引用和内核oops。修复方案是为这些跟踪函数添加额外的包装层，使其能够安全地被低级入口代码调用。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: fix oops caused by irqsoff latency tracer

The trace_hardirqs_{on,off}() require the caller to setup frame pointer
properly. This because these two functions use macro 'CALLER_ADDR1' (aka.
__builtin_return_address(1)) to acquire caller info. If the $fp is used
for other purpose, the code generated this macro (as below) could trigger
memory access fault.

   0xffffffff8011510e <+80>:    ld      a1,-16(s0)
   0xffffffff80115112 <+84>:    ld      s2,-8(a1)  # <-- paging fault here

The oops message during booting if compiled with 'irqoff' tracer enabled:
[    0.039615][    T0] Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at virtual address 00000000000000f8
[    0.041925][    T0] Oops [#1]

This because the $fp(aka. $s0) register is not used as frame pointer in the

		bnez s0, restore_all

                andi s0, s0, _TIF_NEED_RESCHED

                call preempt_schedule_irq
                j restore_all

To fix above issue, here we add one extra level wrapper for function
trace_hardirqs_{on,off}() so they can be safely called by low level entry
code.

classified_cves.summary: Linux内核RISC-V架构存在vmap栈溢出竞争条件漏洞。当检测到vmap栈溢出时，多个硬件线程可能同时使用相同的影子栈，导致竞争条件。通过引入原子变量spin_shadow_stack来解决该问题。
key_points: vmap栈溢出检测时存在竞争条件
多个hart可能同时使用相同的影子栈
通过原子交换操作解决竞争问题
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V架构在Linux内核中的vmap栈溢出处理机制。当检测到栈溢出时，系统会先切换到影子栈，然后调用get_overflow_stack()获取溢出栈。问题在于多个硬件线程（hart）可能同时使用同一个影子栈，造成竞争条件。修复方案是引入spin_shadow_stack原子变量，通过原子交换操作（包含AQ内存序）在自身地址和0之间切换，当变量被设置时表示影子栈正在使用，清除时表示空闲。Palmer补充了AQ内存序要求和相关注释以确保正确性。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: fix race when vmap stack overflow

Currently, when detecting vmap stack overflow, riscv firstly switches
to the so called shadow stack, then use this shadow stack to call the
get_overflow_stack() to get the overflow stack. However, there's
a race here if two or more harts use the same shadow stack at the same
time.

To solve this race, we introduce spin_shadow_stack atomic var, which
will be swap between its own address and 0 in atomic way, when the
var is set, it means the shadow_stack is being used; when the var
is cleared, it means the shadow_stack isn't being used.

[Palmer: Add AQ to the swap, and also some comments.]

classified_cves.summary: 该CVE涉及RISC-V架构下Linux内核的EFI页表同步问题。当启用VMAP_STACK时，若内核栈分配在新的PGD中，切换至EFI页表会导致内核陷入陷阱并引发系统崩溃。修复方案是在切换前同步EFI页表的内核映射。
key_points: VMAP_STACK启用时内核栈分配在vmalloc区域
EFI页表初始化为内核页表副本但未实时同步新PGD映射
访问未同步的vmalloc内核栈时触发陷阱导致内核恐慌
classified_cves.technical_details: 技术细节说明：该漏洞本质是页表同步时序问题。EFI页表初始化阶段完整复制内核页表后，当VMAP_STACK机制在vmalloc区域动态分配新PGD层级的栈空间时，EFI页表未同步更新对应内核映射。当系统切换至EFI页表执行时，访问这些新分配的栈内存会触发页错误陷阱。由于EFI模式下缺页异常处理程序可能未适配此场景，最终导致内核恐慌。修复方案通过__efi_sync_low_kernel_mappings()在切换前主动同步内核映射，确保EFI页表包含所有活跃的vmalloc区域映射。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: Sync efi page table's kernel mappings before switching

The EFI page table is initially created as a copy of the kernel page table.
With VMAP_STACK enabled, kernel stacks are allocated in the vmalloc area:
if the stack is allocated in a new PGD (one that was not present at the
moment of the efi page table creation or not synced in a previous vmalloc
fault), the kernel will take a trap when switching to the efi page table
when the vmalloc kernel stack is accessed, resulting in a kernel panic.

Fix that by updating the efi kernel mappings before switching to the efi
page table.

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞是Linux内核中RISC-V架构的内存管理缺陷。由于在引导过程中过早使用设备树的早期副本设置保留内存，导致后续访问保留内存区域时出现内核恐慌。
key_points: 保留内存设置时机错误：使用早期设备树副本初始化保留内存
虚拟地址访问异常：of_reserved_mem_lookup()使用预虚拟内存地址导致内核崩溃
修复方案：将early_init_fdt_scan_reserved_mem()移至setup_arch()中的early_init_dt_verify()之后执行
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞的技术核心在于RISC-V架构在引导过程中对保留内存的处理时序问题。具体表现为：1）early_init_fdt_scan_reserved_mem()在过早阶段被调用，此时使用的是dtb_early_va设置的initial_boot_params；2）当后续通过of_reserved_mem_lookup()访问保留内存区域时，指针仍指向早期的预虚拟内存地址（如0x00000000401c31ac）；3）在尝试访问缓冲区名称时，由于虚拟内存映射尚未完全建立，导致内核页错误和系统崩溃。修复方法是将保留内存扫描推迟到setup_arch()中直接调用early_init_dt_verify()之后，确保使用正确的虚拟内存地址。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: fix reserved memory setup

Currently, RISC-V sets up reserved memory using the "early" copy of the
device tree. As a result, when trying to get a reserved memory region
using of_reserved_mem_lookup(), the pointer to reserved memory regions
is using the early, pre-virtual-memory address which causes a kernel
panic when trying to use the buffer's name:

early_init_fdt_scan_reserved_mem() takes no arguments as it operates on
initial_boot_params, which is populated by early_init_dt_verify(). On
RISC-V, early_init_dt_verify() is called twice. Once, directly, in
setup_arch() if CONFIG_BUILTIN_DTB is not enabled and once indirectly,
very early in the boot process, by parse_dtb() when it calls
early_init_dt_scan_nodes().

This first call uses dtb_early_va to set initial_boot_params, which is
not usable later in the boot process when
early_init_fdt_scan_reserved_mem() is called. On arm64 for example, the
corresponding call to early_init_dt_scan_nodes() uses fixmap addresses
and doesn't suffer the same fate.

Move early_init_fdt_scan_reserved_mem() further along the boot sequence,
after the direct call to early_init_dt_verify() in setup_arch() so that
the names use the correct virtual memory addresses. The above supposed
that CONFIG_BUILTIN_DTB was not set, but should work equally in the case
where it is - unflatted_and_copy_device_tree() also updates
initial_boot_params.

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞是Linux内核中RISC-V架构的一个安全问题，在进程创建时thread_struct结构体的s[12]数组可能包含未初始化的内核内存内容，最终可能泄露给用户空间。通过在fork时清除s[12]数组来修复此漏洞。
key_points: thread_struct结构体中的s[12]数组未正确初始化
可能泄露内核内存内容到用户空间
影响fork和kthread创建过程
classified_cves.technical_details: 在RISC-V架构的Linux内核实现中，当创建新进程（通过fork系统调用）或内核线程时，thread_struct结构体中的s[12]寄存器保存数组未能被正确初始化，可能包含先前使用的内核内存数据。这些敏感的内核数据可能通过用户空间程序被读取，造成信息泄露。修复方案是在fork和创建内核线程时显式清除s[12]数组的内容。该漏洞主要影响RISC-V架构的Linux系统，需要特定条件才能被利用。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: process: fix kernel info leakage

thread_struct's s[12] may contain random kernel memory content, which
may be finally leaked to userspace. This is a security hole. Fix it
by clearing the s[12] array in thread_struct when fork.

As for kthread case, it's better to clear the s[12] array as well.

classified_cves.summary: 该CVE涉及RISC-V架构Linux内核中的uprobe实现缺陷。在uprobe执行过程中，错误地设置/清除SR_SPIE寄存器导致在中断禁用状态下触发页面故障，引发内核警告。修复方案是移除不必要的SR_SPIE寄存器操作。
key_points: uprobe执行流程中SR_SPIE寄存器处理不当
中断禁用状态下触发页面故障导致内核警告
修复方法为移除arch_uprobe_pre/post/abort_xol中的SR_SPIE操作
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞位于RISC-V架构的Linux内核uprobe实现中。在arch_uprobe_pre_xol函数执行原始指令前会清除SR_SPIE（Supervisor Previous Interrupt Enable）标志，执行后再重新设置。但当访问存放原始指令的页面时可能发生页面故障，而此时中断已被禁用，导致系统检测到在无效上下文中调用睡眠函数（如获取读锁），触发内核警告。技术根源在于不必要的SR_SPIE操作，最终通过完全移除这些操作来修复问题。

classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞属于DLL劫持类安全问题，由于英特尔Pathfinder for RISC-V软件在加载动态链接库时未正确限制搜索路径，攻击者可在优先搜索的目录中放置恶意动态库。当认证用户运行该软件时，系统会加载恶意库而非合法库，从而导致权限提升。漏洞利用需要攻击者已获得本地访问权限，但成功利用后可获得更高系统权限。

descriptions.value: Uncontrolled search path in some Intel(R) Pathfinder for RISC-V software may allow an authenticated user to potentially enable escalation of privilege via local access.

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的RISC-V架构补丁机制中，当尝试修补位于退出段（exit section）的代码时，未进行正确验证。这会导致内核错误调用vmalloc_to_page()函数，引发系统崩溃。
key_points: 漏洞涉及RISC-V架构的内核代码热补丁机制
缺少对目标代码段是否为退出段的检查
错误处理流程触发vmalloc_to_page()导致内核恐慌
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞的技术核心在于：当Linux内核需要对RISC-V架构的运行时代码进行动态修补时，修补函数未能正确识别目标代码是否位于内核的退出段（包含__exit标记的代码段）。由于退出段通常不在常规的vmalloc映射区域内，当错误地尝试通过vmalloc_to_page()转换这类地址时，会触发内核恐慌（panic），导致系统不可用。这属于内核内存管理层面的边界条件处理缺陷，影响系统稳定性和可靠性。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: VMAP_STACK overflow detection thread-safe

commit 31da94c25aea ("riscv: add VMAP_STACK overflow detection") added
support for CONFIG_VMAP_STACK. If overflow is detected, CPU switches to
`shadow_stack` temporarily before switching finally to per-cpu
`overflow_stack`.

If two CPUs/harts are racing and end up in over flowing kernel stack, one
or both will end up corrupting each other state because `shadow_stack` is
not per-cpu. This patch optimizes per-cpu overflow stack switch by
directly picking per-cpu `overflow_stack` and gets rid of `shadow_stack`.

Following are the changes in this patch

 - Defines an asm macro to obtain per-cpu symbols in destination
   register.
 - In entry.S, when overflow is detected, per-cpu overflow stack is
   located using per-cpu asm macro. Computing per-cpu symbol requires
   a temporary register. x31 is saved away into CSR_SCRATCH
   (CSR_SCRATCH is anyways zero since we're in kernel).

Please see Links for additional relevant disccussion and alternative
solution.

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/MADV_COLLAPSE: catch !none !huge !bad pmd lookups

In commit 34488399fa08 ("mm/madvise: add file and shmem support to
MADV_COLLAPSE") we make the following change to find_pmd_or_thp_or_none():

	-       if (!pmd_present(pmde))
	-               return SCAN_PMD_NULL;
	+       if (pmd_none(pmde))
	+               return SCAN_PMD_NONE;

This was for-use by MADV_COLLAPSE file/shmem codepaths, where
MADV_COLLAPSE might identify a pte-mapped hugepage, only to have
khugepaged race-in, free the pte table, and clear the pmd.  Such codepaths
include:

A) If we find a suitably-aligned compound page of order HPAGE_PMD_ORDER
   already in the pagecache.
B) In retract_page_tables(), if we fail to grab mmap_lock for the target
   mm/address.

In these cases, collapse_pte_mapped_thp() really does expect a none (not
just !present) pmd, and we want to suitably identify that case separate
from the case where no pmd is found, or it's a bad-pmd (of course, many
things could happen once we drop mmap_lock, and the pmd could plausibly
undergo multiple transitions due to intervening fault, split, etc). 
Regardless, the code is prepared install a huge-pmd only when the existing
pmd entry is either a genuine pte-table-mapping-pmd, or the none-pmd.

However, the commit introduces a logical hole; namely, that we've allowed
!none- && !huge- && !bad-pmds to be classified as genuine
pte-table-mapping-pmds.  One such example that could leak through are swap
entries.  The pmd values aren't checked again before use in
pte_offset_map_lock(), which is expecting nothing less than a genuine
pte-table-mapping-pmd.

We want to put back the !pmd_present() check (below the pmd_none() check),
but need to be careful to deal with subtleties in pmd transitions and
treatments by various arch.

The issue is that __split_huge_pmd_locked() temporarily clears the present
bit (or otherwise marks the entry as invalid), but pmd_present() and
pmd_trans_huge() still need to return true while the pmd is in this
transitory state.  For example, x86's pmd_present() also checks the
_PAGE_PSE , riscv's version also checks the _PAGE_LEAF bit, and arm64 also
checks a PMD_PRESENT_INVALID bit.

Covering all 4 cases for x86 (all checks done on the same pmd value):

1) pmd_present() && pmd_trans_huge()
   All we actually know here is that the PSE bit is set. Either:
   a) We aren't racing with __split_huge_page(), and PRESENT or PROTNONE
      is set.
      => huge-pmd
   b) We are currently racing with __split_huge_page().  The danger here
      is that we proceed as-if we have a huge-pmd, but really we are
      looking at a pte-mapping-pmd.  So, what is the risk of this
      danger?

      The only relevant path is:

	madvise_collapse() -> collapse_pte_mapped_thp()

      Where we might just incorrectly report back "success", when really
      the memory isn't pmd-backed.  This is fine, since split could
      happen immediately after (actually) successful madvise_collapse().
      So, it should be safe to just assume huge-pmd here.

2) pmd_present() && !pmd_trans_huge()
   Either:
   a) PSE not set and either PRESENT or PROTNONE is.
      => pte-table-mapping pmd (or PROT_NONE)
   b) devmap.  This routine can be called immediately after
      unlocking/locking mmap_lock -- or called with no locks held (see
      khugepaged_scan_mm_slot()), so previous VMA checks have since been
      invalidated.

3) !pmd_present() && pmd_trans_huge()
  Not possible.

4) !pmd_present() && !pmd_trans_huge()
  Neither PRESENT nor PROTNONE set
  => not present

I've checked all archs that implement pmd_trans_huge() (arm64, riscv,
powerpc, longarch, x86, mips, s390) and this logic roughly translates
(though devmap treatment is unique to x86 and powerpc, and (3) doesn't
necessarily hold in general -- but that doesn't matter since
!pmd_present() always takes failure path).

Also, add a comment above find_pmd_or_thp_or_none()
---truncated---

classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞源于RISC-V PMU驱动在性能事件溢出处理时的逻辑缺陷。当性能监控事件产生过多中断时，perf框架会通过perf_sample_event_took()降低采样率并进行限制。但在解除限制时，由于pmu_sbi_ovf_handler()中未调用riscv_pmu_stop()来更新PERF_HES_STOPPED标志，导致后续riscv_pmu_start()函数中的WARN_ON_ONCE检查触发内核警告。通过对比Arm、Loongarch等其他架构的实现，发现它们均未在*_pmu_start()中进行此类标志检查，因此修复方案是直接移除riscv_pmu_start()中的PERF_HES_STOPPED标志验证逻辑。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

perf: RISC-V: Remove PERF_HES_STOPPED flag checking in riscv_pmu_start()

Since commit 096b52fd2bb4 ("perf: RISC-V: throttle perf events") the
perf_sample_event_took() function was added to report time spent in
overflow interrupts. If the interrupt takes too long, the perf framework
will lower the sysctl_perf_event_sample_rate and max_samples_per_tick.
When hwc->interrupts is larger than max_samples_per_tick, the
hwc->interrupts will be set to MAX_INTERRUPTS, and events will be
throttled within the __perf_event_account_interrupt() function.

However, the RISC-V PMU driver doesn't call riscv_pmu_stop() to update the
PERF_HES_STOPPED flag after perf_event_overflow() in pmu_sbi_ovf_handler()
function to avoid throttling. When the perf framework unthrottled the event
in the timer interrupt handler, it triggers riscv_pmu_start() function
and causes a WARN_ON_ONCE() warning, as shown below:

key_points: RISC-V架构下ftrace使用AUIPC+JALR指令对实现长跳转
内核抢占可能导致指令对执行期间被中断并修改跳转地址
地址修改错误造成XLEN:12位与11:0位地址混用
classified_cves.technical_details: 技术细节：在RISC-V架构中，ftrace使用AUIPC（高位立即数加载）和JALR（跳转链接寄存器）指令组合实现超过4K范围的跳转。当启用内核抢占时，任务可能在执行AUIPC指令后被切换出CPU，在此期间如果ftrace函数被动态修改，当任务重新调度执行JALR指令时，会使用部分旧地址（XLEN:12位）和部分新地址（11:0位）组合的错误跳转地址，导致系统崩溃。修复方案是通过禁用抢占来确保指令对的原子性执行。

classified_cves.technical_details: 漏洞核心在于内核创建用户模式辅助线程时，childregs结构体中的gp寄存器保留内核态全局指针值。攻击者可通过：1)PTRACE_GETREGSET附加未执行exec的线程 2)PERF_SAMPLE_REGS_USER采样 3)追踪基础设施等多种方式获取内核地址。虽然需要特定条件触发，但可能绕过LOCKDOWN_PERF防护机制暴露内核内存布局。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: process: Fix kernel gp leakage

childregs represents the registers which are active for the new thread
in user context. For a kernel thread, childregs->gp is never used since
the kernel gp is not touched by switch_to. For a user mode helper, the
gp value can be observed in user space after execve or possibly by other
means.

[From the email thread]

The /* Kernel thread */ comment is somewhat inaccurate in that it is also used
for user_mode_helper threads, which exec a user process, e.g. /sbin/init or
when /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern is a pipe. Such threads do not have
PF_KTHREAD set and are valid targets for ptrace etc. even before they exec.

childregs is the *user* context during syscall execution and it is observable
from userspace in at least five ways:

1. kernel_execve does not currently clear integer registers, so the starting
   register state for PID 1 and other user processes started by the kernel has
   sp = user stack, gp = kernel __global_pointer$, all other integer registers
   zeroed by the memset in the patch comment.

   This is a bug in its own right, but I'm unwilling to bet that it is the only
   way to exploit the issue addressed by this patch.

2. ptrace(PTRACE_GETREGSET): you can PTRACE_ATTACH to a user_mode_helper thread
   before it execs, but ptrace requires SIGSTOP to be delivered which can only
   happen at user/kernel boundaries.

3. /proc/*/task/*/syscall: this is perfectly happy to read pt_regs for
   user_mode_helpers before the exec completes, but gp is not one of the
   registers it returns.

4. PERF_SAMPLE_REGS_USER: LOCKDOWN_PERF normally prevents access to kernel
   addresses via PERF_SAMPLE_REGS_INTR, but due to this bug kernel addresses
   are also exposed via PERF_SAMPLE_REGS_USER which is permitted under
   LOCKDOWN_PERF. I have not attempted to write exploit code.

5. Much of the tracing infrastructure allows access to user registers. I have
   not attempted to determine which forms of tracing allow access to user
   registers without already allowing access to kernel registers.

cna.title: riscv: process: Fix kernel gp leakage

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞是Linux内核RISC-V架构中rt_sigreturn()系统调用存在的向量状态恢复缺陷。当从信号处理程序返回时，错误的向量状态同步机制会导致用户态向量寄存器状态损坏，进而引发应用程序崩溃。
key_points: 向量状态同步错误：在rt_sigreturn()中未正确清理向量实时状态脏标记
触发条件：需启用CONFIG_RISCV_ISA_V_UCOPY_THRESHOLD且vlen>128b
根本原因：向量化user_from_copy()操作前未将实时状态标记为clean
classified_cves.technical_details: 根据RISC-V向量规范，执行系统调用会丢弃调用者保存的向量寄存器状态。在rt_sigreturn()执行过程中：1）进入系统调用时向量实时状态被丢弃并标记为dirty；2）从sigcontext恢复向量状态时，由于dirty标记未清除，向量化user_from_copy()会将已丢弃的实时状态错误保存至vstate；3）最终导致任务向量状态损坏。修复方案是在恢复vstate前显式将实时状态标记为clean。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: Fix vector state restore in rt_sigreturn()

The RISC-V Vector specification states in "Appendix D: Calling
Convention for Vector State" [1] that "Executing a system call causes
all caller-saved vector registers (v0-v31, vl, vtype) and vstart to
become unspecified.". In the RISC-V kernel this is called "discarding
the vstate".

Returning from a signal handler via the rt_sigreturn() syscall, vector
discard is also performed. However, this is not an issue since the
vector state should be restored from the sigcontext, and therefore not
care about the vector discard.

The "live state" is the actual vector register in the running context,
and the "vstate" is the vector state of the task. A dirty live state,
means that the vstate and live state are not in synch.

When vectorized user_from_copy() was introduced, an bug sneaked in at
the restoration code, related to the discard of the live state.

An example when this go wrong:

  1. A userland application is executing vector code
  2. The application receives a signal, and the signal handler is
     entered.
  3. The application returns from the signal handler, using the
     rt_sigreturn() syscall.
  4. The live vector state is discarded upon entering the
     rt_sigreturn(), and the live state is marked as "dirty", indicating
     that the live state need to be synchronized with the current
     vstate.
  5. rt_sigreturn() restores the vstate, except the Vector registers,
     from the sigcontext
  6. rt_sigreturn() restores the Vector registers, from the sigcontext,
     and now the vectorized user_from_copy() is used. The dirty live
     state from the discard is saved to the vstate, making the vstate
     corrupt.
  7. rt_sigreturn() returns to the application, which crashes due to
     corrupted vstate.

Note that the vectorized user_from_copy() is invoked depending on the
value of CONFIG_RISCV_ISA_V_UCOPY_THRESHOLD. Default is 768, which
means that vlen has to be larger than 128b for this bug to trigger.

The fix is simply to mark the live state as non-dirty/clean prior
performing the vstate restore.

cna.title: riscv: Fix vector state restore in rt_sigreturn()

key_points: NOMMU模式下PAGE_OFFSET固定为内核加载地址
内存初始化时mem_map数组越界访问
commit 3335068f8721引入的线性映射修改不兼容NOMMU
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞源于RISC-V架构的NOMMU（无内存管理单元）特殊配置。当使用PUD/P4D/PGD页表进行线性映射时，NOMMU模式的PAGE_OFFSET被固定为内核加载地址，导致ARCH_PFN_OFFSET以下的物理帧号对应到mem_map数组的负索引位置。在mm初始化过程中，这种越界访问会破坏相邻的内核数据结构，可能引发系统崩溃或不可预测行为。修复方案是专门为NOMMU内核恢复原有的内存映射处理逻辑。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: Fix loading 64-bit NOMMU kernels past the start of RAM

commit 3335068f8721 ("riscv: Use PUD/P4D/PGD pages for the linear
mapping") added logic to allow using RAM below the kernel load address.
However, this does not work for NOMMU, where PAGE_OFFSET is fixed to the
kernel load address. Since that range of memory corresponds to PFNs
below ARCH_PFN_OFFSET, mm initialization runs off the beginning of
mem_map and corrupts adjacent kernel memory. Fix this by restoring the
previous behavior for NOMMU kernels.

cna.title: riscv: Fix loading 64-bit NOMMU kernels past the start of RAM

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞是Linux内核中RISC-V架构在64位NOMMU（无内存管理单元）配置下的TASK_SIZE定义错误。当物理RAM存在4GB以上内存时，会导致用户空间访问例程出现虚假故障，影响用户态内存的正常访问。
key_points: 影响64位NOMMU配置的RISC-V系统
TASK_SIZE定义未正确考虑4GB以上物理内存
导致用户空间内存访问异常
classified_cves.technical_details: 在RISC-V NOMMU架构中，用户空间内存可以直接映射到物理RAM的任何位置。当前TASK_SIZE的定义基于32位地址空间假设（4GB限制），当系统实际物理RAM超过4GB时，该定义变得不正确。这会导致内核在验证用户空间地址时错误地拒绝合法访问，表现为用户空间程序无法正常访问高位物理内存区域。修复需要根据实际物理内存布局动态调整TASK_SIZE的值，确保用户空间能够正确访问所有可用的物理内存资源。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: Fix TASK_SIZE on 64-bit NOMMU

On NOMMU, userspace memory can come from anywhere in physical RAM. The
current definition of TASK_SIZE is wrong if any RAM exists above 4G,
causing spurious failures in the userspace access routines.

cna.title: riscv: Fix TASK_SIZE on 64-bit NOMMU

classified_cves.summary: 在Linux内核中，RISC-V架构的次要引导线程存在内核线程栈与pt_regs结构重叠的问题，导致寄存器状态可能被破坏。该漏洞在启用向量扩展(V)的CPU热插拔测试中触发，造成内核尝试保存或恢复不存在的向量上下文。
key_points: 次要空闲线程的栈与pt_regs内存区域重叠
smp_callin函数栈操作破坏pt_regs状态字段
未正确继承主线程的栈保留修复（c7cdd96eca28补丁）
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞源于RISC-V架构中内核线程栈顶未预留pt_regs空间的设计缺陷。次要引导硬件的空闲线程栈与pt_regs结构共享内存区域，当执行smp_callin函数时，寄存器保存操作会覆盖pt_regs的关键字段（包括状态寄存器）。这会导致内核误判向量扩展上下文状态，进而引发上下文保存/恢复异常。该问题与早期主线程修复（commit c7cdd96eca28）形成对称性缺陷，主要影响支持向量扩展和CPU热插拔的系统。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: prevent pt_regs corruption for secondary idle threads

Top of the kernel thread stack should be reserved for pt_regs. However
this is not the case for the idle threads of the secondary boot harts.
Their stacks overlap with their pt_regs, so both may get corrupted.

Similar issue has been fixed for the primary hart, see c7cdd96eca28
("riscv: prevent stack corruption by reserving task_pt_regs(p) early").
However that fix was not propagated to the secondary harts. The problem
has been noticed in some CPU hotplug tests with V enabled. The function
smp_callin stored several registers on stack, corrupting top of pt_regs
structure including status field. As a result, kernel attempted to save
or restore inexistent V context.

cna.title: riscv: prevent pt_regs corruption for secondary idle threads

classified_cves.summary: 该CVE涉及Linux内核中RISC-V架构的__kernel_map_pages()函数存在原子上下文中睡眠的问题。该调试函数在清除页表项有效位时可能获取信号量导致睡眠，违反了原子操作的约束。最终通过重写函数使用apply_to_existing_page_range()方法解决了此问题。
key_points: __kernel_map_pages()在原子上下文中调用时可能睡眠
__set_memory()操作会获取init_mm信号量违反原子性约束
使用apply_to_existing_page_range()重写避免了锁操作
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞的核心技术问题在于：__kernel_map_pages()作为调试函数，用于通过清除已释放页面页表项的有效位来检测非法内存访问。但该函数调用__set_memory()时会获取init_mm的读写信号量，这一操作可能进入睡眠状态。当函数在原子上下文（如中断处理、内核线程创建等场景）中被调用时，睡眠操作违反了内核的原子性约束，导致系统出现'睡眠函数在无效上下文中调用'的警告。解决方案是使用apply_to_existing_page_range()接口重写函数逻辑，该方案无需加锁，因为__kernel_map_pages()处理的页面正处于分配/释放过程中，在此期间不会被其他操作修改。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: rewrite __kernel_map_pages() to fix sleeping in invalid context

__kernel_map_pages() is a debug function which clears the valid bit in page
table entry for deallocated pages to detect illegal memory accesses to
freed pages.

This function set/clear the valid bit using __set_memory(). __set_memory()
acquires init_mm's semaphore, and this operation may sleep. This is
problematic, because  __kernel_map_pages() can be called in atomic context,
and thus is illegal to sleep. An example warning that this causes:

in_atomic(): 1, irqs_disabled(): 0, non_block: 0, pid: 2, name: kthreadd
preempt_count: 2, expected: 0

Hardware name: riscv-virtio,qemu (DT)

[<ffffffff8092bb24>] dump_stack+0x14/0x1c
[<ffffffff8003b7ac>] __might_resched+0x104/0x10e
[<ffffffff8003b7f4>] __might_sleep+0x3e/0x62
[<ffffffff8093276a>] down_write+0x20/0x72
[<ffffffff8000cf00>] __set_memory+0x82/0x2fa
[<ffffffff8000d324>] __kernel_map_pages+0x5a/0xd4
[<ffffffff80196cca>] __alloc_pages_bulk+0x3b2/0x43a

cna.title: riscv: rewrite __kernel_map_pages() to fix sleeping in invalid context

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V架构在Linux内核的kexec崩溃路径中存在的死锁问题。当中断上下文中调用kexec崩溃代码时，会因获取irqdesc自旋锁与停用irqchip的操作导致系统僵死。修复方案为移除无实际作用的irq_set_irqchip_state()调用。
key_points: 中断上下文中触发kexec崩溃路径时产生死锁
machine_kexec_mask_interrupts()函数尝试获取irqdesc自旋锁时与irq_set_irqchip_state()形成循环依赖
RISC-V仅需irq_eoi处理程序即可完成EOI操作，移除冗余函数调用可消除死锁
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞本质是内核同步机制缺陷。当系统在中断上下文中执行kexec崩溃处理时，machine_kexec_mask_interrupts()会先获取irq_desc->lock自旋锁，随后调用irq_set_irqchip_state()尝试停用中断控制器。但后者在某些情况下可能反向请求相同锁资源，形成AB-BA式死锁。与arm64架构不同，RISC-V架构只需通过irq_eoi回调完成中断结束处理，保留irq_set_irqchip_state()不仅无用反而引入死锁风险。修复方案直接移除该函数调用，既保持功能完整又消除锁冲突。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: kexec: Avoid deadlock in kexec crash path

If the kexec crash code is called in the interrupt context, the
machine_kexec_mask_interrupts() function will trigger a deadlock while
trying to acquire the irqdesc spinlock and then deactivate irqchip in
irq_set_irqchip_state() function.

Unlike arm64, riscv only requires irq_eoi handler to complete EOI and
keeping irq_set_irqchip_state() will only leave this possible deadlock
without any use. So we simply remove it.

cna.title: riscv: kexec: Avoid deadlock in kexec crash path

classified_cves.summary: 该CVE涉及Linux内核中RISC-V架构的页面错误处理漏洞。当发生VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV错误时，系统未能正确处理导致内核BUG()而非终止进程。补丁通过添加对VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV的处理确保正确终止违规进程。
key_points: mm_fault_error()函数缺少VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV处理
漏洞导致内核触发BUG()而非正常终止进程
影响RISC-V架构的页面错误处理路径
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞位于Linux内核的RISC-V内存管理子系统（riscv/mm）。当页面错误处理程序遇到VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV（内存访问违规）时，由于mm_fault_error()函数未包含对应的处理逻辑，会导致内核执行BUG()操作造成系统崩溃。修复方案是在mm_fault_error()中新增对VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV的处理分支，使其能正确发送SIGSEGV信号终止违规进程，维持系统稳定性。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv/mm: Add handling for VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV in mm_fault_error()

Handle VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV in the page fault path so that we correctly
kill the process and we don't BUG() the kernel.

cna.title: riscv/mm: Add handling for VM_FAULT_SIGSEGV in mm_fault_error()

classified_cves.summary: 该CVE涉及Linux内核中RISC-V架构的BPF子系统，在准备蹦床图像时存在边界外访问问题。由于在试运行阶段和实际补丁阶段对`im`参数的处理不一致，导致RV64架构下生成指令数量不同，可能引发内存越界。
key_points: 蹦床图像大小计算不一致
emit_imm指令生成数量在试运行和实际执行阶段不同
RV64架构下可能产生内存越界访问
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞源于commit 26ef208c209a引入的架构变化。在BPF蹦床图像准备过程中，试运行阶段获取的图像大小与实际补丁阶段使用的`im`参数不一致。具体来说，在RV64架构中，emit_imm函数在生成立即数地址时，由于参数状态不同，可能产生不同数量的指令。这种不一致性导致预先分配的内存空间可能不足以容纳实际生成的指令，从而造成越界写入。修复方案是在试运行阶段就按照最大指令数量进行估算，确保内存分配充足。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv, bpf: Fix out-of-bounds issue when preparing trampoline image

We get the size of the trampoline image during the dry run phase and
allocate memory based on that size. The allocated image will then be
populated with instructions during the real patch phase. But after
commit 26ef208c209a ("bpf: Use arch_bpf_trampoline_size"), the `im`
argument is inconsistent in the dry run and real patch phase. This may
cause emit_imm in RV64 to generate a different number of instructions
when generating the 'im' address, potentially causing out-of-bounds
issues. Let's emit the maximum number of instructions for the "im"
address during dry run to fix this problem.

cna.title: riscv, bpf: Fix out-of-bounds issue when preparing trampoline image

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞涉及Linux内核中RISC-V架构的purgatory组件，当内核委托处理对齐异常时，purgatory中的代码未正确进行字对齐，可能导致系统崩溃。该问题已在JH7110 SoC平台上通过测试验证。
key_points: purgatory组件中riscv_kernel_entry未正确对齐
当内核委托处理未对齐访问异常时可能触发崩溃
影响kexec异常处理机制的正常运行
classified_cves.technical_details: 在RISC-V架构中，当对齐异常处理被委托给内核时，purgatory中的所有内容必须进行字对齐。由于riscv_kernel_entry未正确对齐，当触发异常时会跳转到kexec的陷阱处理程序，但由于对齐问题最终导致系统崩溃。正常情况下内核的处理程序会处理这些异常，但在此特定配置下（如JH7110 SoC使用oreboot和SBI委托未对齐访问异常，且内核配置为处理这些异常），缺少对齐会导致严重问题。该漏洞暴露了在内核启动早期阶段对架构特性支持不完善的问题。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv/purgatory: align riscv_kernel_entry

When alignment handling is delegated to the kernel, everything must be
word-aligned in purgatory, since the trap handler is then set to the
kexec one. Without the alignment, hitting the exception would
ultimately crash. On other occasions, the kernel's handler would take
care of exceptions.
This has been tested on a JH7110 SoC with oreboot and its SBI delegating
unaligned access exceptions and the kernel configured to handle them.

cna.title: riscv/purgatory: align riscv_kernel_entry

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞是Linux内核中RISC-V架构特有的二进制格式处理缺陷。当启用CONFIG_BINFMT_FLAT_NO_DATA_START_OFFSET配置时，未正确禁用共享库指针数组初始化代码，导致文本段末尾内存损坏。
key_points: RISC-V特定FLAT格式处理缺陷
共享库指针数组越界写入
文本段末尾内存损坏
classified_cves.technical_details: 漏洞源于commit 04d82a6d0881引入的RISC-V FLAT格式优化，当配置CONFIG_BINFMT_FLAT_NO_DATA_START_OFFSET时未保留共享库指针空间，但初始化代码仍会执行，导致在DATA段前的sizeof(long)字节（通常为文本段末尾）被错误覆盖。通过引入MAX_SHARED_LIBS_UPDATE条件编译保护修复。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

binfmt_flat: Fix corruption when not offsetting data start

Commit 04d82a6d0881 ("binfmt_flat: allow not offsetting data start")
introduced a RISC-V specific variant of the FLAT format which does
not allocate any space for the (obsolete) array of shared library
pointers. However, it did not disable the code which initializes the
array, resulting in the corruption of sizeof(long) bytes before the DATA
segment, generally the end of the TEXT segment.

Introduce MAX_SHARED_LIBS_UPDATE which depends on the state of
CONFIG_BINFMT_FLAT_NO_DATA_START_OFFSET to guard the initialization of
the shared library pointer region so that it will only be initialized
if space is reserved for it.

cna.title: binfmt_flat: Fix corruption when not offsetting data start

classified_cves.summary: 该CVE涉及Linux内核中RISC-V架构的内存访问漏洞。由于raw_copy_{to,from}_user()函数未调用access_ok()验证，导致用户空间可以访问任意内核虚拟内存地址。这是一个严重的内核权限绕过漏洞。
key_points: raw_copy_to_user和raw_copy_from_user函数缺少access_ok()检查
允许用户空间程序访问任意内核内存地址
涉及RISC-V架构的未对齐内存访问处理
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞位于Linux内核的RISC-V架构特定代码中，具体在misaligned内存访问处理模块。raw_copy_to_user和raw_copy_from_user作为底层内存拷贝函数，设计上不包含access_ok()验证，本应仅在内核内部使用。但由于代码逻辑缺陷，用户空间可以通过特定路径调用这些函数，从而绕过内存权限检查，直接读写内核空间任意地址。这可能导致权限提升、信息泄露或系统崩溃等严重后果。漏洞影响所有使用受影响Linux内核版本的RISC-V系统。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: misaligned: Restrict user access to kernel memory

raw_copy_{to,from}_user() do not call access_ok(), so this code allowed
userspace to access any virtual memory address.

cna.title: riscv: misaligned: Restrict user access to kernel memory

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的RISC-V KVM模块中，当启用SBI PMU快照功能时，强制关闭虚拟机会导致空指针崩溃。问题出现在kvm_pmu_clear_snapshot_area()函数试图在释放数据前清零PMU快照区域。
key_points: 漏洞触发条件：启用SBI PMU快照的虚拟机被强制关闭
根本原因：kvm_pmu_clear_snapshot_area()函数在释放数据前错误地尝试清零PMU快照区域
影响范围：使用RISC-V KVM虚拟化且启用PMU快照功能的Linux系统
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞的技术细节如下：1) 在Linux内核6.11-rc3中，当虚拟机配置了SBI PMU快照功能并被强制关闭时，kvm_pmu_clear_snapshot_area()函数会调用kvm_vcpu_write_guest()来清零PMU快照区域；2) 此时相关的guest内存可能已被释放，导致空指针解引用崩溃；3) 修复方案是简化kvm_pmu_clear_snapshot_area()逻辑，不再在虚拟机销毁时清零PMU快照区域，因为虚拟机本身正在被销毁；4) 该函数在虚拟机更改VCPU的PMU快照区域时也会被调用，此时同样不应清零之前的快照区域，因为guest可能已将该区域用于其他目的。

classified_cves.summary: Botan密码库在3.6.0之前版本中，当使用特定LLVM编译器（如LLVM 15）编译RISC-V架构代码时，GHASH实现存在编译器诱导的秘密依赖控制流漏洞。该漏洞在AES-GCM的GHASH运算中用分支判断替代了应有的带进位异或操作，可能导致侧信道攻击。
key_points: 漏洞存在于Botan密码库的GHASH实现（lib/utils/ghash/ghash.cpp）
特定编译器（LLVM 15）在RISC-V架构上产生非恒定时间代码
控制流依赖秘密数据，存在侧信道攻击风险
影响AES-GCM加密模式的安全性
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞是编译器优化引入的侧信道漏洞。在RISC-V架构下，当使用LLVM 15等特定编译器编译Botan库的GHASH函数时，编译器错误地将本应使用恒定时间实现的带进位异或操作（XOR with carry）优化为条件分支操作。这种秘密依赖的控制流使得攻击者可能通过计时攻击或功耗分析等手段推断出加密密钥或其他敏感信息。漏洞特别影响AES-GCM加密模式中的GHASH认证运算，破坏了加密方案应有的侧信道安全性。

descriptions.value: Botan before 3.6.0, when certain LLVM versions are used, has compiler-induced secret-dependent control flow in lib/utils/ghash/ghash.cpp in GHASH in AES-GCM. There is a branch instead of an XOR with carry. This was observed for Clang in LLVM 15 on RISC-V.

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞涉及Linux内核中RISC-V架构的缓存叶子节点处理逻辑。当启用ACPI时，代码会提前返回而未释放已获取的CPU设备节点引用，导致引用计数错误。修复方案通过调整节点获取时机并添加错误检查来确保资源正确释放。
key_points: ACPI启用路径中缺少of_node_put调用导致CPU设备节点引用计数泄漏
通过延迟CPU设备节点获取时机至ACPI处理块之后保证资源释放
新增错误检查机制处理节点获取失败情况（返回-ENOENT）
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的RISC-V架构特定代码中，具体在drivers/of/cache.c的cache_setup_acpi_cpu_node函数内。原始实现会在函数起始处调用of_get_cpu_node获取CPU设备节点，但在ACPI启用分支中提前返回时未调用of_node_put释放节点引用。修复后：1. 将节点获取操作移至ACPI处理块之后；2. 添加节点获取失败的返回值检查；3. 确保所有执行路径均能正确释放节点引用。此问题虽不直接导致权限提升，但可能引起内核内存泄漏或系统稳定性问题。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: Prevent a bad reference count on CPU nodes

When populating cache leaves we previously fetched the CPU device node
at the very beginning. But when ACPI is enabled we go through a
specific branch which returns early and does not call 'of_node_put' for
the node that was acquired.

Since we are not using a CPU device node for the ACPI code anyways, we
can simply move the initialization of it just passed the ACPI block, and
we are guaranteed to have an 'of_node_put' call for the acquired node.
This prevents a bad reference count of the CPU device node.

Moreover, the previous function did not check for errors when acquiring
the device node, so a return -ENOENT has been added for that case.

cna.title: riscv: Prevent a bad reference count on CPU nodes

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的RISC-V KVM模块中，在kvm_riscv_vcpu_sbi_init()函数中存在数组越界访问问题。当处理SBI扩展时，未对entry->ext_idx进行边界检查，可能导致内核内存越界访问。
key_points: kvm_riscv_vcpu_sbi_init()函数中的数组越界访问
entry->ext_idx未进行边界检查
特殊标记值被直接用作数组索引
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞的技术细节如下：在RISC-V KVM虚拟化模块初始化过程中，kvm_riscv_vcpu_sbi_init()函数负责初始化SBI（Supervisor Binary Interface）扩展。其中entry->ext_idx被用作特殊标记来表示基础扩展（这些扩展不能被禁用），但在遍历扩展列表时，代码未对该索引值进行越界检查就直接用作数组下标。这可能导致访问到数组边界之外的内存区域，造成内核不稳定或潜在的安全风险。修复方案是在索引数组前添加适当的边界检查逻辑。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: kvm: Fix out-of-bounds array access

In kvm_riscv_vcpu_sbi_init() the entry->ext_idx can contain an
out-of-bound index. This is used as a special marker for the base
extensions, that cannot be disabled. However, when traversing the
extensions, that special marker is not checked prior indexing the
array.

Add an out-of-bounds check to the function.

classified_cves.summary: 在Linux内核的RISC-V架构中，kfence_protect_page()函数在中断禁用状态下错误使用了IPI（处理器间中断）来刷新所有核心的TLB，导致内核警告。修复方案改为仅刷新本地TLB，通过延迟的kfence页错误处理机制来容忍潜在的不一致性。
key_points: IPI在中断禁用环境下的不当使用
TLB刷新机制与kfence保护的冲突
通过本地TLB刷新+延迟错误处理的优化方案
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V架构下Linux内核的内存保护机制。当kfence_protect_page()调用flush_tlb_kernel_range()时，该函数会通过IPI强制所有CPU核心刷新TLB，但在中断禁用上下文（如中断处理程序）中执行此操作会触发smp_call_function_many_cond()的警告。技术根本原因是：1）IPI机制要求中断可用 2）全局TLB刷新在特定上下文中不可行。修复方案采用保守策略：仅刷新本地TLB，允许其他核心可能暂时持有旧的受保护页表项，通过后续页错误处理进行纠正。这种设计权衡接受了短暂的内存保护不一致性，但避免了系统稳定性问题。

classified_cves.technical_details: 技术细节说明：在RISC-V 64位系统中，当使用SPARSEMEM_VMEMMAP内存模型时，vmemmap页表通过直接分配页面并调用vmemmap_set_pmd()进行填充，而非使用标准的pmd_alloc()或RISC-V特定的create_pgd_mapping()/alloc_pmd_late()机制。这导致pmd构造函数未被调用。然而在拆卸这些页表时，清理代码无条件调用了pmd析构函数，造成内核BUG和系统崩溃。该问题在运行HMM自测试（test_hmm.sh smoke）并卸载测试模块时触发，表现为VM_BUG_ON_PAGE(ptdesc->pmd_huge_pte)错误。修复方案是在vmemmap_free()调用上下文中添加检查，避免调用pmd析构函数。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: mm: Do not call pmd dtor on vmemmap page table teardown

The vmemmap's, which is used for RV64 with SPARSEMEM_VMEMMAP, page
tables are populated using pmd (page middle directory) hugetables.
However, the pmd allocation is not using the generic mechanism used by
the VMA code (e.g. pmd_alloc()), or the RISC-V specific
create_pgd_mapping()/alloc_pmd_late(). Instead, the vmemmap page table
code allocates a page, and calls vmemmap_set_pmd(). This results in
that the pmd ctor is *not* called, nor would it make sense to do so.

Now, when tearing down a vmemmap page table pmd, the cleanup code
would unconditionally, and incorrectly call the pmd dtor, which
results in a crash (best case).

key_points: 驱动加载顺序问题导致空指针解引用
缺少父级MSI域时触发系统崩溃
使用dev_err_probe()实现优雅的错误处理
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞技术核心在于RISC-V中断控制器的初始化依赖关系：1) APLIC(Advanced Platform-Level Interrupt Controller)需要IMSIC(Incoming Message Signaled Interrupt Controller)提供的MSI域作为父域 2) 当APLIC先于IMSIC被探测时，msi_create_device_irq_domain()会尝试访问不存在的父域指针 3) 修复方案采用-EPROBE_DEFER机制，使驱动能安全地等待依赖组件初始化完成 4) 使用dev_err_probe()避免了不必要的错误日志输出

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

irqchip/riscv-aplic: Prevent crash when MSI domain is missing

If the APLIC driver is probed before the IMSIC driver, the parent MSI
domain will be missing, which causes a NULL pointer dereference in
msi_create_device_irq_domain().

Avoid this by deferring probe until the parent MSI domain is available. Use
dev_err_probe() to avoid printing an error message when returning
-EPROBE_DEFER.

cna.title: irqchip/riscv-aplic: Prevent crash when MSI domain is missing

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞是Linux内核中HugeTLB页表管理的一个引用计数错误。当通过try_get_folio()等函数意外增加folio引用计数时，huge_pmd_unshare()中的共享检查会出错，导致页表泄露和内存管理异常。
key_points: HugeTLB页表共享计数检查缺陷
folio引用计数意外增加导致误判
页表泄露引发Bad page state内核错误
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及Linux内核内存管理子系统中的HugeTLB功能。核心问题在于huge_pmd_unshare()函数使用folio引用计数来判断PMD页表是否共享，但当通过split_huge_pages、damon、offline_page等路径调用try_get_folio()时，引用计数会被意外增加，导致共享检查失效。这会造成两个严重后果：1）页表本身因报告'nonzero mapcount'而被错误丢弃；2）HugeTLB页面由于页表被误判为共享而无法正确解除映射，最终导致内存泄露。修复方案是引入独立的PMD页表共享计数（pt_share_count），避免与其他引用计数机制冲突。该漏洞可被多种内存管理工具触发，影响系统稳定性。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm: hugetlb: independent PMD page table shared count

The folio refcount may be increased unexpectly through try_get_folio() by
caller such as split_huge_pages.  In huge_pmd_unshare(), we use refcount
to check whether a pmd page table is shared.  The check is incorrect if
the refcount is increased by the above caller, and this can cause the page
table leaked:

The issue may be triggered by damon, offline_page, page_idle, etc, which
will increase the refcount of page table.

1. The page table itself will be discarded after reporting the
   "nonzero mapcount".

2. The HugeTLB page mapped by the page table miss freeing since we

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: mm: Fix the out of bound issue of vmemmap address

In sparse vmemmap model, the virtual address of vmemmap is calculated as:
((struct page *)VMEMMAP_START - (phys_ram_base >> PAGE_SHIFT)).
And the struct page's va can be calculated with an offset:
(vmemmap + (pfn)).

However, when initializing struct pages, kernel actually starts from the
first page from the same section that phys_ram_base belongs to. If the
first page's physical address is not (phys_ram_base >> PAGE_SHIFT), then
we get an va below VMEMMAP_START when calculating va for it's struct page.

For example, if phys_ram_base starts from 0x82000000 with pfn 0x82000, the
first page in the same section is actually pfn 0x80000. During
init_unavailable_range(), we will initialize struct page for pfn 0x80000
with virtual address ((struct page *)VMEMMAP_START - 0x2000), which is
below VMEMMAP_START as well as PCI_IO_END.

This commit fixes this bug by introducing a new variable
'vmemmap_start_pfn' which is aligned with memory section size and using
it to calculate vmemmap address instead of phys_ram_base.

cna.title: riscv: mm: Fix the out of bound issue of vmemmap address

classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V架构在Linux内核中的uprobes实现。uprobes使用XOL（execute out-of-line）缓冲区来单步执行被替换的指令。由于在构建XOL缓冲区后缺少fence.i指令，指令缓存（i$）未能及时刷新，导致CPU可能执行缓存中的旧指令而非新构建的指令。这种内存一致性错误在Spacemit K1/X60平台上运行BPF自测程序（test_progs: uprobe_autoattach, attach_probe）时表现为随机性故障。fence.i指令在RISC-V中用于同步指令缓存和数据缓存，确保后续指令获取能够看到最新的指令内容。

riscv: uprobes: Add missing fence.i after building the XOL buffer

replaced instruction(s) for uprobes. The RISC-V port was missing a

uprobes tests randomly blew up.

(kernel/sched/core.c) doing the following:

asmlinkage __visible void schedule_tail(struct task_struct *prev)
{
...
        if (current->set_child_tid)
                put_user(task_pid_vnr(current), current->set_child_tid);
...
}

the put_user() macro causes the code sequence to come out as follows:

1:	__enable_user_access()
2:	reg = task_pid_vnr(current);
3:	*current->set_child_tid = reg;
4:	__disable_user_access()

The problem is that we may have a sleeping function as argument which
could clear SR_SUM causing the panic above. This was fixed by
evaluating the argument of the put_user() macro outside the user-enabled
section in commit 285a76bb2cf5 ("riscv: evaluate put_user() arg before
enabling user access")"

In order for riscv to take advantage of unsafe_get/put_XXX() macros and
to avoid the same issue we had with put_user() and sleeping functions we
must ensure code flow can go through switch_to() from within a region of
code with SR_SUM enabled and come back with SR_SUM still enabled. This
patch addresses the problem allowing future work to enable full use of
unsafe_get/put_XXX() macros without needing to take a CSR bit flip cost
on every access. Make switch_to() save and restore SR_SUM.

cna.title: riscv: save the SR_SUM status over switches

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: cpu_ops_sbi: Use static array for boot_data

Since commit 6b9f29b81b15 ("riscv: Enable pcpu page first chunk
allocator"), if NUMA is enabled, the page percpu allocator may be used
on very sparse configurations, or when requested on boot with
percpu_alloc=page.

In that case, percpu data gets put in the vmalloc area. However,
sbi_hsm_hart_start() needs the physical address of a sbi_hart_boot_data,
and simply assumes that __pa() would work. This causes the just started
hart to immediately access an invalid address and hang.

Fortunately, struct sbi_hart_boot_data is not too large, so we can
simply allocate an array for boot_data statically, putting it in the
kernel image.

This fixes NUMA=y SMP boot on Sophgo SG2042.

classified_cves.summary: 该CVE涉及Linux内核中RISC-V架构的运行时常量修复功能缺陷。在无内存管理单元（nommu）内核中，当处理32位地址高位为零的情况时，__runtime_fixup_32函数错误地生成无效指针，导致内核崩溃。
key_points: __runtime_fixup_32函数对val=0情况处理不当
错误生成两个nop指令而非正确的指令序列
导致寄存器中残留随机数据形成无效指针
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞的核心技术问题在于：当处理物理地址低于4GiB边界且高32位全零的情况时，代码逻辑缺陷导致连续执行两个else分支，错误地生成两个nop指令。这造成本应存储高32位零值的寄存器保留随机数据，与低32位值组合后形成无效指针。当内核后续访问该指针时触发内核恐慌（kernel panic）。修复方案需要确保当第一条指令被修补为nop时，第二条指令能正确调整为li指令而非addi。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

riscv: fix runtime constant support for nommu kernels

the `__runtime_fixup_32` function does not handle the case where `val` is
zero correctly (as might occur when patching a nommu kernel and referring
to a physical address below the 4GiB boundary whose upper 32 bits are all
zero) because nothing in the existing logic prevents the code from taking
the `else` branch of both nop-checks and emitting two `nop` instructions.

This leaves random garbage in the register that is supposed to receive the
upper 32 bits of the pointer instead of zero that when combined with the
value for the lower 32 bits yields an invalid pointer and causes a kernel
panic when that pointer is eventually accessed.

The author clearly considered the fact that if the `lui` is converted into
a `nop` that the second instruction needs to be adjusted to become an `li`
instead of an `addi`, hence introducing the `addi_insn_mask` variable, but
didn't follow that logic through fully to the case where the `else` branch
executes. To fix it just adjust the logic to ensure that the second `else`
branch is not taken if the first instruction will be patched to a `nop`.

cna.title: riscv: fix runtime constant support for nommu kernels

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞源于Linux内核中RISC-V架构的TASK_SIZE_MAX定义优化不当。原优化将TASK_SIZE_MAX改为LONG_MAX以提升access_ok()性能，但导致地址验证不完整，使得TASK_SIZE至LONG_MAX之间的非法用户地址被错误放行，影响futex等系统调用的安全性。
key_points: TASK_SIZE_MAX错误定义为LONG_MAX导致地址验证漏洞
get_user_pages_fast()接受非法地址范围(TASK_SIZE, LONG_MAX)
futex等依赖用户地址验证的机制受影响
classified_cves.technical_details: 技术细节说明：该漏洞的核心问题在于RISC-V架构的__access_ok()验证逻辑缺陷。原优化commit ad5643cf2f69将TASK_SIZE_MAX从默认的TASK_SIZE改为LONG_MAX，基于'用户地址<LONG_MAX<内核地址'的假设。但实际上TASK_SIZE到LONG_MAX之间的地址虽非有效用户地址，却被硬件视为合法。特别地，get_user_pages_fast()未正确过滤此区间地址，而futex等系统调用依赖该机制进行用户空间地址验证，导致可能访问非法内存区域。最终通过revert恢复TASK_SIZE_MAX为TASK_SIZE确保正确性，但牺牲了部分性能。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Revert "riscv: Define TASK_SIZE_MAX for __access_ok()"

This reverts commit ad5643cf2f69 ("riscv: Define TASK_SIZE_MAX for
__access_ok()").

This commit changes TASK_SIZE_MAX to be LONG_MAX to optimize access_ok(),
because the previous TASK_SIZE_MAX (default to TASK_SIZE) requires some
computation.

The reasoning was that all user addresses are less than LONG_MAX, and all
kernel addresses are greater than LONG_MAX. Therefore access_ok() can
filter kernel addresses.

Addresses between TASK_SIZE and LONG_MAX are not valid user addresses, but
access_ok() let them pass. That was thought to be okay, because they are
not valid addresses at hardware level.

Unfortunately, one case is missed: get_user_pages_fast() happily accepts
addresses between TASK_SIZE and LONG_MAX. futex(), for instance, uses
get_user_pages_fast(). This causes the problem reported by Robert [1].

Therefore, revert this commit. TASK_SIZE_MAX is changed to the default:
TASK_SIZE.

This unfortunately reduces performance, because TASK_SIZE is more expensive
to compute compared to LONG_MAX. But correctness first, we can think about
optimization later, if required.

cna.title: Revert "riscv: Define TASK_SIZE_MAX for __access_ok()"

中间级页表被释放后，转储代码仍可能访问已释放内存

classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V平台内核页表调试机制。当通过/sys/kernel/debug/kernel_page_tables接口转储页表时，内存热移除操作会同时修改页表结构。若中间页表层级被释放，ptdump代码继续访问会导致野指针解引用。与arm64、s390等架构类似，RISC-V需要通过get_online_mems()/put_online_mems()保护操作序列。修复后统一在ptdump_walk_pgd()内部加锁，同时覆盖check_wx_pages检查路径。

descriptions.value:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/ptdump: take the memory hotplug lock inside ptdump_walk_pgd()

Memory hot remove unmaps and tears down various kernel page table regions
as required.  The ptdump code can race with concurrent modifications of
the kernel page tables.  When leaf entries are modified concurrently, the
dump code may log stale or inconsistent information for a VA range, but
this is otherwise not harmful.

But when intermediate levels of kernel page table are freed, the dump code
will continue to use memory that has been freed and potentially
reallocated for another purpose.  In such cases, the ptdump code may
dereference bogus addresses, leading to a number of potential problems.

To avoid the above mentioned race condition, platforms such as arm64,
riscv and s390 take memory hotplug lock, while dumping kernel page table
via the sysfs interface /sys/kernel/debug/kernel_page_tables.

Similar race condition exists while checking for pages that might have
been marked W+X via /sys/kernel/debug/kernel_page_tables/check_wx_pages
which in turn calls ptdump_check_wx().  Instead of solving this race
condition again, let's just move the memory hotplug lock inside generic
ptdump_check_wx() which will benefit both the scenarios.

Drop get_online_mems() and put_online_mems() combination from all existing
platform ptdump code paths.

cna.title: mm/ptdump: take the memory hotplug lock inside ptdump_walk_pgd()

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞存在于Linux内核的RISC-V IOMMU驱动中，当riscv_iommu_pte_fetch()函数返回NULL时，riscv_iommu_iova_to_phys()函数未能正确处理空指针情况。这可能导致内核空指针解引用，引发系统崩溃或安全风险。

riscv_iommu_iova_to_phys()未检查NULL返回值
移除了不必要的PTE验证逻辑

commit bf454ec31add新增字段后架构间初始化不一致

classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞源于Linux内核kexec子系统中的内存初始化缺陷。具体来说：1）kexec_buf结构体在load_other_segments()函数中声明时未进行初始化；2）commit bf454ec31add引入的新字段在所有架构中未保持一致的初始化状态；3）当读取未初始化的_Bool类型字段时，会触发UBSAN（未定义行为消毒剂）警告，因为加载的值252不是有效的_Bool值（应为0或1）；4）这可能导致内核在kexec操作过程中使用垃圾值，影响系统稳定性。补丁方案是在声明时对kexec_buf进行零初始化，确保所有字段处于已知状态。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

arm64: kexec: initialize kexec_buf struct in load_other_segments()

Patch series "kexec: Fix invalid field access".

The kexec_buf structure was previously declared without initialization. 
commit bf454ec31add ("kexec_file: allow to place kexec_buf randomly")
added a field that is always read but not consistently populated by all
architectures.  This un-initialized field will contain garbage.

This is also triggering a UBSAN warning when the uninitialized data was
accessed:

	------------[ cut here ]------------
	UBSAN: invalid-load in ./include/linux/kexec.h:210:10
	load of value 252 is not a valid value for type '_Bool'

Zero-initializing kexec_buf at declaration ensures all fields are cleanly
set, preventing future instances of uninitialized memory being used.

An initial fix was already landed for arm64[0], and this patchset fixes
the problem on the remaining arm64 code and on riscv, as raised by Mark.

Discussions about this problem could be found at[1][2].

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V架构的Linux内核KVM模块，在写入hgatp寄存器时未正确处理Bare模式下的字段清零要求。根据RISC-V特权架构规范，当选择MODE=Bare时，必须将hgatp寄存器的其余字段置零，而当前实现存在违规操作。
key_points: hgatp寄存器模式位设置不符合RISC-V特权架构规范
Bare模式下未正确清零非模式字段
漏洞影响KVM虚拟化的地址转换机制
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞本质是RISC-V KVM实现中对hgatp（Hypervisor Guest Address Translation and Protection）寄存器的写入违反架构规范。具体表现为：当hgatp.MODE字段设置为Bare（无地址转换）模式时，架构要求寄存器中除MODE字段外的其他字段（包括VMID和PPN）必须强制清零，但内核代码未严格执行此规定。这可能导致虚拟化环境中的地址转换行为异常，可能被利用造成虚拟机逃逸或系统不稳定。修复方案是通过预检测硬件支持的合法模式，确保在Bare模式下正确清零相关字段。

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

RISC-V: KVM: Write hgatp register with valid mode bits

According to the RISC-V Privileged Architecture Spec, when MODE=Bare
is selected,software must write zero to the remaining fields of hgatp.

We have detected the valid mode supported by the HW before, So using a
valid mode to detect how many vmid bits are supported.

cna.title: RISC-V: KVM: Write hgatp register with valid mode bits

classified_cves.summary: 该CVE涉及Linux内核中RISC-V架构的BPF子系统漏洞。在结构体操作（struct ops）返回指针值时，未正确进行符号扩展，导致内核页面错误和系统崩溃。该漏洞在ns_bpf_qdisc自测中触发，表现为无法处理内核分页请求。
key_points: BPF结构体操作返回指针值时符号扩展错误
违反RISC-V ABI调用规范
导致内核页面错误和系统崩溃
classified_cves.technical_details: 技术细节：1) bpf_fifo_dequeue程序返回的skb指针被当作32位值处理，在函数尾声错误地进行符号扩展到64位；2) 虽然这种处理对大多数BPF程序类型正确，但违反了结构体操作对RISC-V ABI的要求；3) 漏洞触发条件是在网络数据包处理路径中（__qdisc_run），当BPF程序返回指针时，错误的符号扩展导致虚拟地址ffffffffa38dbf58处出现内核分页错误，最终引发内核崩溃。修复方案是根据函数模型和RISC-V ABI规范正确进行符号扩展。

classified_cves.summary: 开源RISC-V处理器在提交f517abb中存在mstatus.SUM位保留不当的漏洞，该位非零状态违反了特权规范约束，可能导致物理内存访问攻击。
key_points: mstatus.SUM位错误保留为非零值
违反RISC-V特权架构规范约束
可能被利用进行物理内存越权访问
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V处理器的特权架构实现缺陷。mstatus寄存器中的SUM(Supervisor User Memory access)位用于控制监管模式下的用户内存访问权限。根据RISC-V特权规范，该位在特定场景下应被正确清零，但受影响版本在提交f517abb中未能正确处理，导致SUM位异常保留为非零状态。这使得在监管模式下可能绕过正常的内存保护机制，直接访问用户空间内存，造成权限提升和内存数据泄露风险。该漏洞属于硬件/微架构层面的权限控制缺陷。

descriptions.value: Improper mstatus.SUM bit retention (non-zero) in Open-Source RISC-V Processor commit f517abb violates privileged spec constraints, enabling potential physical memory access attacks.

classified_cves.summary: RISC-V BOOMv1.2处理器在SV39模式下存在地址转换漏洞，即使页表条目配置了正确的写入权限，存储指令仍可能错误触发访问故障。该漏洞在进入虚拟内存并尝试向映射的内核内存执行存储操作时复现，可能导致内核崩溃或拒绝服务。
key_points: SV39模式下虚拟到物理地址转换异常
具有写入权限的页表条目仍错误触发存储访问故障
影响内核内存存储操作，可能导致系统不稳定
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V BOOMv1.2处理器的内存管理单元(MMU)或物理内存保护(PMP)逻辑缺陷。在SV39分页模式下，当页表条目(PTE)正确配置了写入权限(PTE_W)时，执行存储指令(sd)本应正常完成，但实际却错误触发了Store/AMO访问故障。这表明处理器在验证内存访问权限时存在逻辑错误，特别是在虚拟内存转换过程中对写入权限的检查机制存在缺陷。漏洞在尝试向已映射的内核内存区域执行存储操作时显现，可能破坏系统稳定性，导致内核恐慌或拒绝服务条件。

descriptions.value: A vulnerability exists in riscv-boom SonicBOOM 1.2 (BOOMv1.2) processor implementation, where valid virtual-to-physical address translations configured with write permissions (PTE_W) in SV39 mode may incorrectly trigger a Store/AMO access fault during store instructions (sd). This occurs despite the presence of proper page table entries and valid memory access modes. The fault is reproducible when transitioning into virtual memory and attempting store operations in mapped kernel memory, indicating a potential flaw in the MMU, PMP, or memory access enforcement logic. This may cause unexpected kernel panics or denial of service in systems using BOOMv1.2.

classified_cves.summary: RISC Zero zkVM在rv32im电路中存在约束缺失漏洞，恶意证明者可利用该漏洞混淆寄存器值。受影响版本为2.0.0-2.0.2，需升级至2.1.0版本修复。使用官方验证器路由器的智能合约无需操作，其他合约需更新验证器版本。
key_points: rv32im电路约束缺失导致三寄存器指令安全漏洞
恶意证明者可操纵rs1和rs2寄存器值混淆
影响risc0-zkvm 2.0.0-2.0.2版本
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞源于RISC Zero zkVM的rv32im电路实现中缺少对三寄存器指令的充分约束。攻击者可通过恶意构造的证明，使虚拟机错误地将rs1寄存器的值视为与rs2寄存器相同，从而破坏零知识证明系统的完整性。特别影响remu和divu等算术指令，可能被利用来伪造计算结果的正确性验证。技术核心在于电路约束系统未能完全覆盖所有可能的寄存器状态组合，导致验证过程存在逻辑旁路。

cna.title: RISC Zero zkVM Underconstrained Vulnerability

descriptions.description: CWE-345: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity

descriptions.value: RISC Zero is a general computing platform based on zk-STARKs and the RISC-V microarchitecture. Due to a missing constraint in the rv32im circuit, any 3-register RISC-V instruction (including remu and divu) in risc0-zkvm 2.0.0, 2.0.1, and 2.0.2 are vulnerable to an attack by a malicious prover. The main idea for the attack is to confuse the RISC-V virtual machine into treating the value of the rs1 register as the same as the rs2 register due to a lack of constraints in the rv32im circuit. Rust applications using the risc0-zkvm crate at versions 2.0.0, 2.0.1, and 2.0.2 should upgrade to version 2.1.0. Smart contract applications using the official RISC Zero Verifier Router do not need to take any action: zkVM version 2.1 is active on all official routers, and version 2.0 has been disabled. Smart contract applications not using the verifier router should update their contracts to send verification calls to the 2.1 version of the verifier.

classified_cves.summary: RISC Zero零知识证明虚拟机在2.0.0至2.1.0版本中存在整数除法漏洞。有符号整数除法对特定输入允许产生多个输出结果，且除零操作约束不足。该漏洞已在2.2.0和3.0.0版本中修复。
key_points: 有符号整数除法对特定输入存在多结果输出问题
除零操作约束条件不完整
影响risc0-zkvm 2.0.0-2.1.0及risc0-circuit-rv32im系列组件
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V指令集架构中的整数除法运算实现。在零知识证明虚拟机的电路约束层，对有符号整数除法（如DIV指令）的验证约束存在缺陷：1）对于某些特定输入值，电路允许产生多个不同的计算结果，而实际上只有一个是正确的 2）当除数为零时，系统未能施加足够的约束条件来确保确定性的异常处理。这种约束不足可能导致证明验证过程中接受错误的计算结果，破坏零知识证明系统的完整性和安全性。漏洞源于RISC-V指令在zk-STARKs电路实现中的约束条件设计不严谨。

cna.title: RISC Zero Underconstrained Vulnerability: Division

descriptions.value: RISC Zero is a zero-knowledge verifiable general computing platform based on zk-STARKs and the RISC-V microarchitecture. RISC packages risc0-zkvm versions 2.0.0 through 2.1.0 and risc0-circuit-rv32im and risc0-circuit-rv32im-sys versions 2.0.0 through 2.0.4 contain vulnerabilities where signed integer division allows multiple outputs for certain inputs with only one being valid, and division by zero results are underconstrained. This issue is fixed in risc0-zkvm version 2.2.0 and version 3.0.0 for the  risc0-circuit-rv32im and risc0-circuit-rv32im-sys packages.

classified_cves.summary: 在Rocket-Chip特定版本中发现CSR逻辑存在设计缺陷，当在非异常状态下执行MRET指令时可能触发指令访问故障，导致异常处理与异常返回机制同时激活。该冲突会造成控制状态寄存器更新混乱，破坏特权状态转换的完整性。
key_points: MRET在非异常状态下执行时触发指令访问故障
异常处理与异常返回逻辑同时激活产生冲突
CSR寄存器被竞争更新导致特权状态损坏
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞源于Rocket-Chip的CSR模块中异常处理状态机设计缺陷。当CPU处于机器模式但未处理异常时执行MRET指令，会错误触发Instruction Access Fault。此时系统同时进入异常处理流程（保存上下文到mepc/mcause）和异常返回流程（从mepc恢复PC），造成mstatus、mepc等关键CSR寄存器被两个并行逻辑竞争修改。这种状态冲突可能被利用来篡改特权级别或跳过安全检查，最终导致权限提升或系统失控。

descriptions.value: An issue was discovered in Chipsalliance Rocket-Chip commit f517abbf41abb65cea37421d3559f9739efd00a9 (2025-01-29) allowing attackers to corrupt exception handling and privilege state transitions via a flawed interaction between exception handling and MRET return mechanisms in the CSR logic when an exception is triggered during MRET execution. The Control and Status Register (CSR) logic has a flawed interaction between exception handling and exception return (MRET) mechanisms which can cause faulty trap behavior. When the MRET instruction is executed in machine mode without being in an exception state, an Instruction Access Fault may be triggered. This results in both the exception handling logic and the exception return logic activating simultaneously, leading to conflicting updates to the control and status registers.

descriptions.description: CWE-1281 Sequence of Processor Instructions Leads to Unexpected Behavior

classified_cves.summary: RISC Zero zkVM平台在2.0.2及以下版本存在内存写入漏洞，当zkVM客户端调用sys_read时，主机可通过特制响应写入客户端任意内存位置。该漏洞可导致在客户端内执行任意代码，严重破坏零知识证明的可信保证。
key_points: 漏洞核心在sys_read系统调用机制
主机可操控客户端内存地址空间
影响所有使用受影响版本构建的客户端程序
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞存在于RISC-V零知识证明虚拟机的系统调用实现中。当客户端程序通过sys_read请求输入时，主机端未对内存写入操作进行边界检查，攻击者可构造恶意响应数据实现任意内存地址写入。由于zk-STARKs系统的完整性依赖客户端执行环境的隔离性，此漏洞直接破坏了零知识证明系统的可靠性基础。受影响组件包括risc0-zkvm-platform、risc0-aggregation、risc0-zkos-v1compat等多个相关模块。

cna.title: risc0 vulnerable to arbitrary code execution in guest via memory safety failure in `sys_read`

descriptions.description: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

descriptions.value: RISC Zero is a zero-knowledge verifiable general computing platform based on zk-STARKs and the RISC-V microarchitecture. In versions 2.0.2 and below of risc0-zkvm-platform, when the zkVM guest calls sys_read, the host is able to use a crafted response to write to an arbitrary memory location in the guest. This capability can be leveraged to execute arbitrary code within the guest. As sys_read is the mechanism by which input is requested by the guest, all guest programs built with the affected versions are vulnerable. This critically compromises the soundness guarantees of the guest program. Other affected packages include risc0-aggregation versions below 0.9,  risc0-zkos-v1compat below 2.1.0, risc0-zkvm versions between 3.0.0-rc.1 and 3.0.1. This issue has been fixed in the following versions: risc0-zkvm-platform 2.1.0, risc0-zkos-v1compat 2.1.0, risc0-aggregation 0.9, and risc0-zkvm 2.3.2 and 3.0.3.

classified_cves.summary: RISC-V Rocket-Chip v1.6及之前版本存在SRET指令执行漏洞，该指令未能正确降低处理器权限级别，导致从机器模式(M-mode)异常返回时错误地保持高权限状态。这造成了严重的权限保留风险，可能被利用进行未授权操作。
key_points: SRET指令权限切换失效
M-mode权限被错误保留
sstatus.SPP位设置未被正确遵循
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞涉及RISC-V特权架构规范中的异常返回机制。当处理器执行SRET指令时，本应根据sstatus寄存器中的SPP位值从机器模式(M-mode)降级到监管模式(S-mode)，但实际实现中未能完成权限切换。这种权限保留漏洞可能允许恶意代码在不应具备的权限级别执行操作，破坏系统的安全隔离机制。受影响的具体版本为Rocket-Chip v1.6及之前的所有版本。

descriptions.value: A vulnerability was discovered in RISC-V Rocket-Chip v1.6 and before implementation where the SRET (Supervisor-mode Exception Return) instruction fails to correctly transition the processor's privilege level. Instead of downgrading from Machine-mode (M-mode) to Supervisor-mode (S-mode) as specified by the sstatus.SPP bit, the processor incorrectly remains in M-mode, leading to a critical privilege retention vulnerability.

classified_cves.summary: 该漏洞存在于riscv-boom SonicBOOM处理器的L1数据缓存处理组件中，攻击者可通过本地访问利用时序差异进行侧信道攻击。由于攻击复杂度高且利用困难，被评估为中等风险漏洞。
key_points: 影响范围：riscv-boom SonicBOOM 2.2.3及之前版本
漏洞位置：L1数据缓存处理组件
攻击特征：基于时序差异的侧信道攻击
classified_cves.technical_details: 该漏洞属于微架构层面的时序侧信道漏洞。攻击者通过监测L1数据缓存访问的时间差异，可以推断出处理器的缓存状态和内存访问模式。虽然需要本地访问权限且攻击复杂度较高，但可能被用于提取敏感信息。厂商在早期收到披露后未作出响应，建议用户关注后续安全更新。

cna.title: riscv-boom SonicBOOM L1 Data Cache timing discrepancy

descriptions.value: A vulnerability has been found in riscv-boom SonicBOOM up to 2.2.3 and classified as problematic.
